intro: Blood Feeders is a Horde hunting contract given by Xen'Zilla in the Darkspear settlement of Malaka'jin. The local trolls have found plentiful game along the slopes of Stonetalon, but the scent of their butchered meat has drawn swarms of predatory Deepmoss spiders down into their camps.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.
Lately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... The spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.
If you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hey mon, have you slain the hairy blood feeders? I fear none here in Stonetalon but I don't go walking around here at night... If you know what I mean mon!
As long as I stay off their dinner plate then all is well.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Sweet, mon! Good news, perhaps we will have fewer unwanted dinner guests tonight.
Many thanks, friend. We are forever in your debt.
